not-verified: the link was never dropped: the injection point was not reached, so nothing about link loss was measured
a fault injection exercises one failure at one moment; it does not prove the bridge handles every failure mode
link-drop kills passt, which is the closest a non-root Termux process gets to dropping the host link; radio handover and interface-down are not reproducible here
guest-panic needs CONFIG_MAGIC_SYSRQ and a writable /proc/sysrq-trigger in the guest; PANIC_NOT_TRIGGERED in the log means the trigger never reached the kernel
the panic scenario boots a copy of the rootfs and its own command line; it does not prove the release gate's own arguments are right
timing is wall-clock, not deterministic: the fault is injected a fixed delay after the UML process appears
the survivor check is global: another process on the phone whose command line matches a watched token (a second harness run, say) is reported as a survivor too; run device gates one at a time
